## Goal

Make semantic activation analysis change-proportional at truthful semantic decision boundaries. Do not batch analyses into rounds or introduce an activation-cone pass.

## Fresh signal (release compiler, 2026-08-24)

enum_take_drop_split:

- 1,382 AnalyzeActivation evaluations, 276.120 ms;
- 237 unique materialized backend activation keys;
- 186 rebased completions, 300 blocked completions, 153 completions with no changed output fact.

fz_f98_range_map_converges:

- 307 AnalyzeActivation evaluations, 21.677 ms;
- 59 unique materialized backend activation keys;
- 27 rebased completions, 77 blocked completions, 39 completions with no changed output fact.

The backend inventory is not the analyzed-activation inventory. fz-kdt.34 supplies the missing exact identity and wake-cause signal; the earlier SeedActivation count is not a sound denominator.

## Proven ownership smell

analyze_activation is one whole-body formula. One completion publishes independently keyed decisions:

- CallSiteSummary and CallSiteTargets per callsite;
- Activation and ActivationInputs per callee;
- Executable per executable;
- ReturnType and ActivationAnalyzed per activation.

The same formula reads callee ReturnType facts while analyzing calls. Therefore one callee return movement can re-run the whole body and reconsider every independently keyed output. This is a concrete candidate for an overly broad formula boundary, not yet proof that a per-callsite split is sound.

## Strategy — edge-use precision REFUTED by measurement (2026-08-29)

The previous strategy (cross-component callee ReturnType consumed via Settled
waits; two-run discover-then-fold) was BUILT IN FULL, measured A/B in one
binary, and stopped before commit. The mechanism is deadlock-free and safe
(fixture matrix clean, zero uncaused after the fz-kdt.62 fix), but the win is
2-4%: main/0 79 -> 64 evaluations (target was ~2-3), AnalyzeActivation
1,353 -> 1,295 on 00420, blocked completions +31%.

THE REFUTATION, so nobody re-derives it: cross-component in the CALL graph is
not acyclic in the FACT graph. The caller publishes ActivationInputs(callee),
and the callee's ReturnType is a function of those inputs -- caller and callee
are mutually dependent through facts however acyclic the call graph is. So:
(1) a blocked caller dirties ActivationInputs(callee), which keeps
ReturnType(callee) transitively unsettled while the caller waits -- every
cross-component fold must be granted by the drain arbiter, once per drain;
(2) the fold itself changes the callee's inputs, so the "settled" return moves
again after folding and the caller is back to waking per revision.

MEASURED RESIDUAL: the cost is ASCENT HEIGHT, not granularity. main/0
publishes 57 content-CHANGING evaluations (55 after the experiment); only 22
concluded unchanged, of which the mechanism removed 13. The body is
sequential dataflow (x = f(); g(x)), advancing one callsite per convergence
round by construction. The agenda's idempotent enqueue already absorbs most
fan-in.

SALVAGED (landed separately): fz-kdt.61 (CallGraphComponent fact, recursion
from strong components, kdt.56 residual retired) and fz-kdt.62
(demand_producer_if_needed blocked-before-rebased fix, latent uncaused-
evaluation bug). Component structure measured: 119 nodes / 116 components /
largest 3 on 00420 -- the graph is almost entirely singletons, so component
knowledge is cheap and now on the shelf.

OPEN QUESTION for the next attempt, unresolved deliberately: the remaining
excess is the ascent itself (many small real revisions cascading through
sequential dataflow). Candidate directions -- each colliding differently with
this ticket's own "no rounds, no cone pass" prohibition: (a) generational
wake coalescing (drain the wave before re-running a caller -- scheduling
policy, arguably not "rounds"); (b) chunkier monotone joins (fewer, larger
ReturnType ascent steps -- e.g. joining all pending callee evidence in one
evaluation rather than one wake at a time); (c) accept the ascent as the
honest cost of the reactive model on sequential dataflow and re-target the
epic's next win elsewhere (the product-side populations of fz-kdt.57/58).
Decide with the owner before building.

## Acceptance

- Every non-initial semantic formula evaluation names content that moved since its own prior conclusion.
- Semantically equivalent input evidence does not revise a cell.
- Changed facts whose stored semantic value is equal remain zero.
- Moving one callsite's callee evidence does not evaluate unrelated callsite formulas once the boundary is split.
- Unchanged outputs wake no downstream work.
- Repeated runs produce identical causal work multisets.
- Both target fixtures remain byte-correct on interp, run, and build.
- Work-count tests use production telemetry; no wall-clock thresholds.
- No fixture-specific Enum rule or downstream transport/native workaround.

## Documentation

Record the corrected semantic formula boundaries and delete descriptions of the former whole-body ownership where it no longer exists.

## COMMENTS

**2026-08-25T01:36:13Z**
> FOLDED FROM THREE TICKETS. fz-f98.5 ('telemetry-first convergence audit'), fz-f98.14 ('convergence runaway: drive is 1.3s') and fz-bfh.6 ('demand/analysis re-derivation volume, ~1.8k') were evaluated independently by three different agents, and all three arrived at the same measurement on the same fixture: 1382 AnalyzeActivation spans out of 2593 job spans on enum_take_drop_split.
> 
> They differed only in what they blamed, and each blame was stale in its own way: f98.5 blamed a schedule-dependent Seal<->DeriveRuntimeDemand<->Transport cycle (all those job kinds now grep to zero); f98.14 blamed SealSemanticClosure's monolithic reseal (deleted); bfh.6 paired AnalyzeActivation with DeriveRuntimeDemand re-derivation (runtime demand is now a pull product that settles 3 times per drive, not 1.8k).
> 
> Per [[feedback_fold_concordant_ideas]] they are one ticket. Keeping three would have had three people measure the same number and re-derive three dead diagnoses.


## Fresh causal-stream signal (2026-08-28, fz-kdt.34 machinery, debug interp) — folded from fz-kdt.55

Cross-fixture, from the public log's causal replay:

    00420_enum_take_drop_split: 1,382 AnalyzeActivation evals over 319 DISTINCT
      activations -- 1,063 re-evaluations (77%); ~41% of the whole applied stream
    fz_f98_range_map_converges:   307 over  75 -- 232 re-evaluations (76%)
    enum_predicate_search:        934 over 244 -- 690 re-evaluations (74%)

Worst identity: AnalyzeActivation(main/0, arrow 32) runs 83x publishing 58
ActivationAnalyzed revisions (25 runs change NOTHING). Wake causes are callee
ReturnType facts, each bumping 3-5x during the ascent; CallSiteSummary facts
bump 13-14x each (the transmission belt, fz-463). Dispositions 82 enqueued /
17 coalesced -- coalescing exists but the ascent serializes through the wake
loop.

TWO component causes, this ticket owns both or splits deliberately:
1. GRANULARITY (this ticket's original diagnosis): one whole-body formula
   re-runs per single-callsite input move.
2. ASCENT HEIGHT: refinements cascade multiplicatively up the call chain; no
   wave-batching before re-run (generational coalescing: drain the wave, run
   once).

Verification is now cheap: the causal report (telemetry::causal) gives
evals/distinct-activations per fixture; pin the improved ratios as the gate.

- ○ fz-kdt.44 P2 Make settledness transitively sound without recalculating unchanged formulas
- ○ fz-kdt.56 P2 DeriveRecursive is a restart pyramid: one evaluation per call-graph BFS layer

## Inherited residual from fz-kdt.56 (2026-08-28)

fz-kdt.56 flattened the DeriveRecursive restart pyramid (each layer now costs
fact reads, not body re-scans) but its "blocked completions ~zero" check is
deliberately NOT met there: the layered frontier walk itself remains (134
evaluations / 34 blocked on 00420, plus the new DeriveStaticCallees family's
251/129 first-block waits; both pinned in the fz-kdt.56 ratchet). THIS ticket
owns collapsing it: the call-graph component fact this ticket introduces for
same-SCC vs cross-SCC edge classification also makes recursion a component-
membership lookup, taking DeriveRecursive to ~1 evaluation per function and
retiring the layered walk. World::static_callees(f) is the queryable edge
store; see fz-kdt.56's commit for the drop-in shape (CallGraphComponent fact
beside Recursive in demand_fact_producer).
